title: Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The recurrent neural network transducer (RNN-T) remains a practical choice for streaming speech recognition, but training requires large intermediate tensors. We present Flash RNN-T, a joint and loss implementation combining specialized kernels with optional tiled recomputation over the full alignment space and vocabulary. Tiled and untiled Flash form the entire measured throughput-memory frontier on medium and long workloads. On H100, untiled Flash achieves 24-39% higher throughput with 26-56% less memory than the fastest baseline on these workloads wherever it fits. Tiling reduces memory further through recomputation. On medium, tiled Flash uses ninefold less memory than that baseline at 16% lower throughput when both use one backward call per batch. translated_title: Flash RNN-T：内存高效的联合网络与转导损失计算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23409v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：循环神经网络转导器（RNN-T）仍然是流式语音识别的实用选择，但其训练需要大量的中间张量。我们提出了 Flash RNN-T，这是一种联合网络与损失的实现方法，结合了专用内核以及在完整对齐空间和词表上进行可选分块重计算的技术。在中型和长型工作负载上，分块与非分块 Flash 构成了完整的实测吞吐量-内存权衡边界。在 H100 上，在这些工作负载的内存可容纳范围内，非分块 Flash 相比最快基线实现了 24-39% 的更高吞吐量，同时内存使用减少 26-56%。分块技术通过重计算进一步降低内存占用。在中等工作负载上，当两者都采用每批次一次反向调用时，分块 Flash 比该基线节省九倍的内存，但吞吐量降低 16%。在长工作负载上，当所有使用相同反向调度且内存限制为 80 GB 的测试替代方案都耗尽内存时，它仍能正常运行。
tldr: 提出 Flash RNN-T，通过专用内核与分块重计算实现内存高效的 RNN-T 训练，在 H100 上相比最快基线吞吐量提升 24-39%、内存减少 26-56%，分块模式还可将内存占用进一步降低至九分之一。
en_tdlr: Flash RNN-T enables memory-efficient RNN-T training through specialized kernels and optional tiled recomputation, achieving 24-39% higher throughput with 26-56% less memory than the fastest baseline on H100, with tiling further reducing memory up to ninefold.
